messages:
tara: @eng-platform heads-up — ACME Prod (tenant: acme-prod) reporting p99 jump from ~120ms -> ~1.8s since 09:10 UTC. Customer saw increased latency and some 504s. Raised severity. logs show many requests stuck in continuous-batcher. attaching quick metrics.

juno: looking. can you paste the request examples? small payloads or long?

tara: small prompts, median token_count=6, size ~90 bytes. sample trace: ```request_id=bd3f... batcher=continuous-1 queued_for=1120ms backend_latency=45ms```

eli: from infra side, noticed a config change at 09:07 in a canary: 'minibatch_hold_ms' was lowered from 3 -> 1 (attempt to reduce latency for large prompts). lowering hold window here made the coalescer favor waiting for batch_size instead of falling back to greedy-for-small, so tiny requests are now more likely to be queued into a batch and sit ~1s waiting. this matches the p99 spike.

sam: that explains the pattern — many tiny requests hitting the continuous path and getting stuck waiting for a full batch. any quick mitigation we can do while we triage?

deploy-bot: deploy accepted: rollback config 'minibatch_hold_ms' to 3 for service continuous-batcher on canary (version 2026-03-17_09:09) — triggered by juno

juno: rolled back on canary (10% traffic). monitoring live.

eli: pushed hotpatch to routing as an emergency mitigation: force greedy batching for very small payloads (payload_bytes < 256). snippet we applied: ```if (payload.size < 256) route = 'greedy' else route = 'continuous'``` canary -> 10% -> 100% over ~6m.

tara: post-rollout metrics (09:28): p50:48ms p95:210ms p99:240ms QPS 135. customer reports noticeable improvement :thumbsup:

sam: follow-ups: 1) add regression test for tiny-prompt latency against continuous-batcher, 2) add alert rule for batch_queue_depth > 50 sustained >1m, 3) document per-tenant overrides and safe ranges for minibatch_hold_ms.

juno: created ticket INF-8132 for regression tests + alerts + docs. tagging eng-sre for next-week follow-up.

eli: takeaway: decreasing hold window can help for large/long prompts but must be coordinated with greedy-path thresholds or per-tenant policies to avoid harming tiny-prompt SLOs. we'll add a note to the config change playbook.

tara: closing loop with ACME now and will mark as mitigated in the support case.

sam: thanks everyone — quick response prevented a larger outage.
